gen-fs-segment-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Wide-spaced and stocky, Segment announces itself with a tall middle band. Be Vietnam Pro follows in a plain sans with curve endings held well apart, comfortable in small doses.
gen-fs-segment-fs-familjen-grotesk: Segment spaces its letters far apart and packs them with a tall middle band, which gives lines a stocky look. Familjen Grotesk is lively sans-serif text with bowls left open on one side, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-fs-segment-fs-merriweather-sans: Segment spreads its letters wide beneath a tall, stocky middle band. Merriweather Sans has sturdy, large-looking lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, so a plain sans like this is good for a handful of lines, with a heading sized well above it.
gen-fs-segment-fs-nunito: Nunito reads friendly and modern, with big round bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem. Under Segment's wide, stocky heading, a longer passage would feel soft and unhurried.
gen-fs-segment-fs-ranade: Segment's tall middle band makes every line look stocky, with generous gaps between its letters. And Ranade moves with a slight, rubbery shift in weight and widely spaced stroke ends, so this sans adds a gentle organic rhythm that suits a handful of lines.
gen-fs-segment-fs-supreme: Wide, stocky and commanding, Segment makes its entrance. Supreme backs it with a crisp, heavy-looking sans whose letters stay held open, which makes the pair feel made for short stretches of reading.
gen-fs-segment-manrope: Manrope is a bright, wire-like sans with open mouths on its curves. Under Segment's stocky heading, a longer passage would run smooth and approachable, and it is good for a handful of lines.
gen-fs-segment-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and open, with a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut. Segment is its wide, stocky counterpart, and Satoshi keeps each stroke at one width, which makes the pair made for short stretches of reading.
gen-fs-segment-work-sans: Segment leads with wide gaps between letters and a tall, stocky middle band. And Work Sans, a monoweight sans with c tips held well apart, would read in a longer passage as modern and comfortable in small doses.
gen-fs-sharpie-fs-plein: Plein is a reliable, clean sans that channels clearly into every round letter, made for short stretches of reading. Sharpie squeezes tight and bold, while Plein stays open.
